snippet.title: How I made a game using ONLY AI (full story)
snippet.description:
I tried every AI model I could get my hands on to make one game. This is the full story of Codex Mortis - from a Vampire Survivors prototype in a chat window to full release on Steam.

🎮 Codex Mortis 1.0 is out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4084120/CODEX_MORTIS/

💬 Crunchfest Discord: https://discord.gg/fc9ezSaebW
